content.short: Metamorphic Contract Detector detects metamorphic, mutable, and editable Ethereum smart contracts.
content.description: The Metamorphic Contract Detector app and command line interface detects mutable Ethereum smart contracts based on six metamorphic characteristics. Users can get clues to identify metamorphic contracts behind an address. Developers can use the CLI to identify potential security risks in mutable contracts.
content.meta: The Metamorphic Contract Detector detects metamorphic Ethereum contracts. Discover Metamorphic Contract Detector and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
